verdict.rationale: Asana provides technical hooks for handoff — an official MCP server, REST API, webhooks, app components embedding, and status-update sharing to other tools — plus 'AI Teammates' described as having shared memory and Work Graph context. However there's no concrete evidence of end-to-end context preservation when handing off between multiple tools/agents, only first-party marketing claims. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of lossless context transfer, documented examples of multi-agent handoff, and detail on how Work Graph context persists across external tool boundaries.
